title.narrative: Driver of change: community empowerment for environmental protection in East Jerusalem

description.narrative: the action aims to foster environmental protection in East Jerusalem by developing an inclusive strategy for raising awareness on environmental protection, to create a network of citizens initiative to push for environmental rights. ONLUS and its partners proposes to launch two small-scale entrepreneurship experiences in recycling. Outputs are as follows: implementation of a multi-stakeholders strategy for raising awareness on environmental protection, creation of a citizens network...
